**Organ Cave West** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.

A location in The Forest, inhabited by Cult of the Mothman. It is part of the cave system that includes Organ Cave South and Organ Cave North.

Organ Cave West appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.
